title: Measuring (a Sufficient) World Model in LLMs: A Variance Decomposition Framework
reasoning: The paper focuses on introducing a framework to evaluate the internal consistency and 'world model' of LLMs using variance decomposition. While it discusses fairness and equity as motivations for measuring model sensitivity to articulation, the actual evaluation tasks are focused on neutral domains like health, logistics, travel, and personal finance, rather than benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems.
